description: "Create New File" with its module templates (files.new with template; the oracle clicks mniCreateNewFile, the answers check the template in the module selection and give the name to InputQuery): the first template, <new file>.esp (picked with Enter, which takes the first entry), and <new file>.esm with the light flag, the sixth of the Skyrim SE templates (Down five times in the list, whose first entry has the focus, then Enter: the focused entry is taken when none is checked). Each new file gets a record copied into it, as the copy into a new file is how they are used.
